description: GitHub's official MCP server (github.com/github/github-mcp-server), the remote form hosted by GitHub. Token only: a fine-grained personal access token from a Secrets & env file. Non-secret headers narrow it: toolsets, lockdown (hides public issue text from users without push access) and read-only. Tool output is untrusted data.

slots.name: Authorization
slots.description: A fine-grained GitHub token limited to the project's repositories. Read-only sets: Metadata, Contents, Issues and Pull requests, all read.

slots.name: X-MCP-Toolsets
slots.description: Comma-separated toolsets to load. Unknown names are ignored by the server.

slots.name: X-MCP-Lockdown
slots.description: Lockdown mode: a best-effort filter of public issue content from users without push access. Not a security boundary.

slots.name: X-MCP-Readonly
slots.description: true loads only read tools. Set it per set; left out, write tools load too.
